title: How many numbers satisfy the 3x+1 conjecture?
publication: International Journal of Mathematics and Mathematical Sciences 12 (4), 791-796

consultation.scope: Original article's abstract/introduction in the indexed mirror; located Lemma 4, equations (2.4)-(2.5), and Theorem 1 in OCR. Journal metadata checked against EuDML.
consultation.remaining: Full article OCR was located, but displayed formula extraction is damaged and a readable PDF was not retrieved. Detailed inequality and proof verification remains open.

notes: Original difference-inequality source behind the later Applegate-Lagarias and Krasikov-Lagarias methods. The abstract gives a lower bound c*x^(3/7), with a positive constant c, for the count of starts reaching 1. Preserve this multiplicative constant. This is a sublinear counting bound, not a reciprocal-mass divergence theorem.
